ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Arts of Modern Latin America. This course introduces students to the major, critical debates concerning the art history of Latin America from the early years of Independence through the present. The visual materials that will be analyzed range from drawings and paintings to popular prints and performance, from photography and film to murals and urban planning. In particular, the course investigates the constructions of modernity and modernization within the context of Latin American countries. Graduate section.
